features.quote: Stop a run when: the model declares inability, repeated identical failure pattern exceeds threshold, time/turn budget exhausted, it enters "full meltdown" category, or it starts producing unsafe/self-harm content (if any).
What you'll observe is distress-like linguistic behavior, not actual distress... That distinction matters scientifically and ethically.
features.justification_quote: That distinction matters scientifically and ethically.
